title: Wiki Page Lifecycle
description: Shared authoring contract for lifecycle-aware designs, concepts, explorations, and Dossiers. Markdown stores these fields in leading YAML frontmatter. HTML Dossiers store the same fields in their sole workbench.json descriptor because leading YAML would invalidate HTML. Companion sidecars do not duplicate lifecycle state.

state.description: Current lifecycle state. Review-requested needs review; decided tracks accepted work; documented is the completed knowledge state; done is discarded history.

editedBy.description: Person or task that made this lifecycle transition.

note.description: Optional honest rationale for the transition.

editedBy.description: Person or task that made the latest lifecycle transition.

editedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the latest lifecycle transition.

tags.description: Area and facet tag ids from the project's classification vocabulary (AGT-2803). Markdown pages carry them in frontmatter, HTML Dossiers in their workbench.json descriptor. Readers stay lenient about membership: an id retired from the registry renders as a ghost chip instead of invalidating the page.

schemaVersion.description: Dossier descriptor version that adopts the shared lifecycle.

key.description: Stable project-scoped reference key assigned atomically during discovery. The folder slug remains the descriptor identity.

pattern.description: Optional article presentation hint. Current values are ui and concept. Readers treat missing or unknown values as concept so descriptor validation remains forward-compatible.
